description: We are planning to achieve a completed vehicle launch-land mission game, inspired from many other games we plan to include unique and interesting mechanics and our own ideas! We are all 16 and excited to go against people with higher experience!!
summary: A game in which players can choose which spaceship is best suited to their selected mission and then launch their rocket, avoid space debris, and land safely on their chosen planet. Only playable with keyboard.
details: Our game, Comet Escape is a fun interactive game where the player can select the type of rocket they want to control. There are four rockets, which are based off the history of space exploration. They can also pick three different planets to travel to, Saturn, Mars and Earth's Moon (Lunar). Once they press the LAUNCH button after selecting their desired rocket and planet, they will be transported to a space simulation where the player will have to use the arrow keys to dodge comets. The Player will also have the opportunity to collect coins which will be displayed at the end of their mission, whether it has been a success or a fail. If they crash into said comets the game will display "Mission Failed" and you will be redirected back to the home page. The four rocket choices consist of, STS, SLS - based off the first flight ever - , Redstone and Sputnik. Once you click your desired rocket you can read short fact about it. The same occurs when selecting the desired planet as your destination. We wanted to create a game to interest kids in the real history of space travel and lead them to further engage with space. We used Procreate to design and create all the graphics in the game and the platform Godot to write our code. We used limited SI to help with debugging sections of our code.
